oneOf.description: The channel's creator and channel managers.

ChannelCreateFloor.description:
`channels.create_*_floor`: the install-level gate on top of the create bit
(gap G29 as amended by contracts revs 6 and 10).

oneOf.description: The bit plus being a space admin.
The bit plus being an install owner or admin.

DigestDetail.description: Org policy `digest.detail`: what a digest mail names (gap G13).

oneOf.description: Conversations, counts, author names and times.
Only the total and an "Open Sew" link.

MeetingsCreate.description: `meetings.create`: who may host a meeting (Meet MC1).

oneOf.description:
Any active non-guest member of the Meetings Space (on a standalone install, any
active non-guest member: the first create adds them to the Space).
Mentions, DMs, keywords and followed threads.

Policies.description: Every org policy value. `Default` is the C13 defaults.

agents.allowed_in_dms.description: Whether members may DM agent members.

calls.dm_enabled.description:
Whether members may start and join calls in DMs and group DMs (S34 v2 §7.2); off
answers `403 policy_denied` with reason `dm_calls_disabled`.

calls.stats_beacon.description:
The call-stats beacon (F21): on, browsers send aggregate, anonymous call samples
(`POST /api/v1/me/voice/stats`) that Sew adds to `/metrics`; off (the default), joins
carry no `stats` and the route answers `403 policy_denied` `call_stats_off`.

calls.verification_code.description:
Whether "Call info → Security code" is shown (S50 §16.4). Clients read it in READY
`call_keys.verification_code` and the policy digest.

channels.create_private_floor.description: Extra gate on top of CREATE_PRIVATE_CHANNELS.

channels.create_public_floor.description: Extra gate on top of CREATE_PUBLIC_CHANNELS.

digest.detail.description: What an email digest names (S21 gap G13).

files.space_quota_bytes.description: Per-space file quota in bytes; 0 = none.

files.strip_image_location.description:
Strip GPS and other location EXIF/XMP from JPEG, PNG, WebP and HEIC originals when an
upload finishes; orientation and colour profile stay (S15, contracts rev 25 G14).

gifs.api_key_ref.description: Reference to the GIF provider's API key (≤ 256); never the key itself.

gifs.enabled.description: GIF search on/off. Uploaded GIFs always work.

guests.dm_non_channel_mates.description: Whether guests may DM people they share no channel with.

guests.enabled.description:
Guest access on/off (S19 §7.7): off revokes every guest session and refuses guest logins
until it is on again; memberships, roles and DMs stay.

meetings.create.description: Who may host meetings (Meet MC1, §13 Q7).

meetings.enabled.description:
Meetings on/off (Meet MC1): off refuses the meeting routes with `403 policy_denied`
`meetings_disabled`; meetings already made keep their channels.

meetings.grace_minutes.description: Minutes an empty room waits after `ends_at` before the meeting ends (0–720).

meetings.link_guests.description:
Meeting links let outside guests in (Meet MC2a, CC8; default on). Off: `peek` and
`redeem` answer `403 policy_denied`, and every link-guest session is revoked.
`guests.enabled` does not govern link guests.

meetings.privacy_contact.description: Who to ask about meeting privacy (≤ 300 characters; optional).

mentions.channel_max_members.description: Above this many members, `@channel`/`@here` need MANAGE_CHANNELS (≥ 2).

messages.delete_own.description: Whether members may delete their own messages.

messages.deleted_purge_days.description:
Days deleted and edited-away content is kept before S22 purges it; 0 = off (Q12). A
read-only mirror of the install retention row (contracts rev 33 G1).

notifications.default_level.description:
The notification level people's space channels fall back to (S21 gap G1). Agents stay
at `mentions` (contracts rev 11); DMs default to `all`.

private.space_admins_can_join.description: Whether space admins may join private channels by themselves.

recording.audio_default_days.description: The default audio keep days (S35 v2 §12.1).

recording.audio_max_days.description: The most audio keep days (S35 v2 §12.1).

recording.dm_enabled.description: Whether persons may record DM calls (S35 v2; `dm_perms` grants RECORD_CALLS).

recording.enabled.description:
Whether members may record calls (S35 v2 §21.1); off answers `403 policy_denied`
`recording_disabled`.

recording.require_consent_to_join.description: Declining the recording notice means not joining (S35 v2 §9.11, rev 91).

retention.default_days.description: Company retention default in days; 0 = forever.

VerificationCode.description:
Policy `calls.verification_code` (S50 §16.4): whether "Call info → Security code" is
shown. `required` is reserved for a later mode and refused by the policy validator.

oneOf.description: Shown on request, never modal (the default).
Reserved: "confirm before you speak" (refused in v1).
